rationale: v1.80.1 renders the vacuum path under two live-camera owners and converts animated endpoints with a stale view. The fix restores attachment without changing source data, routes, calibration or settings.

summary.ru: Путь пылесоса и его конец сохраняют привязку к плану и роботу при панорамировании и масштабировании.
summary.en: Vacuum paths and their animated ends stay attached to the plan and robot while panning and zooming.
